items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 9 at 8:03PM PST until November 10 at 10:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.
Additionally, dangerous rip currents and surf of 3 to 6 feet
expected along west-facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until noon PST Tuesday.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of parking lots and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Dangerous swimming conditions
due to elevated surf and strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide Tuesday morning is expected to
peak over 7 feet MLLW, which is 1.2 to 1.4 feet above
astronomical tide predictions.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
